# 呢 / 嗰 + Classifier (+ Noun) · *ni1 / go2 + Classifier (+ Noun)*

**Meaning:** this / that · **Level:** A1 · **Topic:** Location and pointing

> **Draft: awaiting native-speaker review.** Spotted something unnatural? Please [report it](https://github.com/jyltsang/cantonlink-community/issues/new?template=content-error.yml&title=%5BCorrection%5D%20grammar%2Fni1-go2-demonstratives).

呢 (this) and 嗰 (that) always need a classifier after them: 呢個, 嗰件, 呢間. The noun can be dropped when it's obvious from context.

**Written Chinese:** 這 / 那 — Written Chinese uses 這 and 那.

## Examples

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **呢個幾多錢呀？** |
| Jyutping | ni1 go3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3? |
| Yale | nī go géi dō chín a? |
| Bopomofo | ㄋㄧ¹ ㄍㄛ³ ㄍㄝㄧ² ㄉㄛ¹ ㄘㄧㄣ² ㄚ³? |
| English | How much is this? |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **我要嗰件。** |
| Jyutping | ngo5 jiu3 go2 gin6. |
| Yale | ngóh yiu gó gihn. |
| Bopomofo | ㆭㄛ⁵ ㄧㄨ³ ㄍㄛ² ㄍㄧㄣ⁶. |
| English | I'd like that one (piece of clothing). |

| | |
|---|---|
| 漢字 | **嗰間餐廳好出名。** |
| Jyutping | go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 hou2 ceot1 meng2. |
| Yale | gó gāan chāan tēng hóu chēut méng. |
| Bopomofo | ㄍㄛ² ㄍㄚㄣ¹ ㄘㄚㄣ¹ ㄊㄝㄥ¹ ㄏㄛㄨ² ㄘㆤㆵ¹ ㄇㄝㄥ². |
| English | That restaurant is very famous. |
